When preparing your dataset for publication, consider the following:

- **Completeness:** UC Berkeley Library Dataverse is designed for finalized data.
- **Documentation:** Include or create documentation (such as a README or codebook) that describes how your dataset was created, defines all variables, and identifies relationships between files. See the Cornell’s [Writing READMEs for Research Data](https://data.research.cornell.edu/data-management/sharing/readme/) guide.
- **Preservation:** Use [open file formats](https://www.nnlm.gov/resources/data/data-glossary/open-file-formats) where possible and closed formats only as necessary.
- **File Organization:** Use consistent [file and folder naming conventions](https://datamanagement.hms.harvard.edu/plan-design/file-naming-conventions).
